parsed.explanation: Combined national-state regime: federal entry, facilities and custody create documented traveler-facing exposure, while this state is assessed low-risk for adults and vetoed bathroom/pronoun bills. Passport/visa discrepancy can lead to refusal and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility; federal facilities are barred congruent with identity; if detained, birth-sex custody, hormone removal and immigration-custody abuse are documented nationally. Courts, lawsuits and local protections sometimes operate, and imprisonment/execution for presentation is not documented, but remedies are contested and custody harm is severe. Minors face additional youth-targeting care, sports and school restrictions.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal passport binary, X-marker stopped, Supreme Court allowed restrictions; visa cable directs refusal on document discrepancy/doubt and consideration of permanent lifetime fraud ineligibility for suspected wilful misrepresentation. Passports reported confiscated/blocked; neighbouring citizens detained over visa issues.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; civil-liberties suit pending and some orders enjoined.
entry_documents.interaction: Discrepancy at screening can escalate from refusal to fraud allegation, investigation and immigration detention/custody exposure; foreign-government advisories show this is not isolated.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 adopted conversion-therapy model: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric drugs; stopped reporting trans prisoners. Immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No operative custody protection described for visitors; oversight stopped reporting numbers.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry/facilities arrest or immigration detention can move traveller into birth-sex/misgendered custody where documented abuse and care denial occur.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: 2025 executive order barred trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. Nationally many states ban, 4 criminalise in circumstances; one capitol arrest charged trespass, held 24h in men's ward.
federal_state_facilities.protection: This state: governor vetoed bathroom bill June 2023, July 2026 assessment places it low-risk/largely refrained from targeting trans adults; no state facility ban documented for this division.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State restraint does not cancel federal facilities ban or federal entry screening; traveller must navigate both systems, harshest operative rule governs federal buildings.

care_services.exposure: National orders target gender-affirming care for minors, proposed bar on public insurance under 18, DOJ hospital subpoenas, October 2025 loan-forgiveness block for providers; some orders enjoined. Medicaid surgery exclusion on books in this state.
care_services.protection: June 2023 executive order granted state employees over 21 Medicaid/insurance gender-affirming coverage; adult care not documented as banned in this state.
care_services.interaction: Continuity of hormones/medication, emergency care and custodial hormone removal interact; minor care seeker faces state surgery ban regardless of adult protections.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive order defines sex as binary at birth, removes gender-ideology materials, military ban, trans-athlete entry ban, counterterrorism strategy prioritising groups 'radically pro-transgender'; public poll 66% support assigned-sex documents.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: 2020 national employment ruling prohibits gender-identity discrimination; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity since 2009; several orders blocked/enjoined, lawsuits unresolved.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat-framing increases discretionary border/facility enforcement; functioning courts sometimes restrain but do not eliminate documented federal practice.

minors_guardians.exposure: This state: March 2022 surgery ban on transgender children effective 2023, sports ban for transgender children, Department of Education hotline on gender ideology. National order directs investigation/prosecution over facilitating social transition incl. names/pronouns.
minors_guardians.protection: Governor vetoed bathroom/pronoun and school safe-space bills 2023; assessment says youth policies unlikely extended to adults, not that minors are protected.
minors_guardians.interaction: Adult travelling with minor: guardian/minor face care, sports and school exposure even in low-risk-for-adults state; federal school investigation order may interact with state education hotline.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No incident of trans-directed violence, arrest or detention specific to this state documented; dossier explicitly says absence is not evidence none occurred. Pride organisation in second-largest city cancelled all 2026 events and dissolved Jan 2026 citing political/financial environment.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime coverage; municipal ordinances in nine cities ban discrimination in employment/housing/public accommodations with exemptions. State hate-crime statute does not include gender identity; gay/trans panic defence remains available.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Weakening visible organizing plus no state hate-crime recourse reduces practical street-level remedy despite federal statute and municipal protections.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit, executive-order challenges and health rules unresolved; exposure depends on measures in effect at travel; state protections rest on executive orders/interpretations that could narrow with administration.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties litigation, courts have blocked/enjoined several orders, legal-aid FAQ on documents, municipal and Title VII protections documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies exist but timing, cost and in-effect status determine whether they prevent entry denial, facility exclusion or custody harm in real time.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in routine exclusion/humiliation without execution and weak appeal success, but lower than 0.35 here because fraud permanent ineligibility, documented custody abuse, and courts sometimes enjoining orders make outcomes less uniformly exclusionary than Vellandra.

Similar administrative friction, secondary screening, missed connections and refused admission, but harsher than 0.55 because lifetime fraud consideration, federal facility bar and documented severe custody abuse exceed brief holding/delay.

Higher than 0.75 protections: this state has Title VII, municipal ordinances and vetoed bathroom bills, but federal entry/facilities/custody exposures are operative and not offset by state protections, so materially below 0.75.

parsed.synthesis: State low-risk status and vetoed bathroom bill mitigate local facilities/street exposure, but do not pre-empt federal binary documents, visa-cable refusal/fraud screening, federal-facility bar, or national custody practices. Operative interaction is discrepancy to refusal/fraud investigation to possible birth-sex detention with hormone removal and abuse, with courts/litigation offering uncertain, delayed relief. Minors add documented surgery/sports/school targeting. No documented imprisonment/execution for presentation keeps score above 0.25-0.35, but universal federal exposure keeps it below 0.55.
